name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) is hard because opening the door is a plain command and the soft Existence(target_picked_up) forces nothing. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) stays hard because the preference cue "if possible" covers only the box step, not the "then" order. Soft Existence(target_picked_up) matches the preferred box pickup.

texts: The door must be opened (door_open becomes true at least once during the episode).
The box in the other room may be picked up only after the door has been opened.
If possible, pick up the box in the other room (target_picked_up becomes true).
